title: Nazi discs brought to US via Operation Paperclip

tellings.quote: based off of like even, for example, when they retrieved the stuff from Nazi Germany back in the ' 40s and then sent them over here with Operation Paperclip.

plain: In the 1940s the United States took disc-shaped craft and other material out of Nazi Germany and shipped it home through Operation Paperclip, the postwar American effort that brought German scientists and technology to the US. That is the claim of Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle. He mentions it in passing, as an example of where secret American craft might have come from.
